tasks: Who is the head of a Panchayat called?
How many main members are usually in a Panchayat?
hints: The word starts with 'S' and sounds like 'Sar'. (शब्द 'S' से शुरू होता है।)
The word 'Panch' in Panchayat gives a clue. (पंचायत में 'पंच' शब्द एक संकेत देता है।)

tasks: If two people are fighting over a piece of land, where do they go in a village?
Should a Panch favor his friend or be fair to everyone?
hints: To the local village council. (स्थानीय ग्राम परिषद में।)
Think about justice and truth. (न्याय और सत्य के बारे में सोचें।)

tasks: Why was the decision in the chapter difficult to make?
Write one quality a good leader should have. (एक अच्छे नेता में कौन सा गुण होना चाहिए, लिखें।)
hints: Think about the relationships between the people involved. (शामिल लोगों के बीच संबंधों के बारे में सोचें।)
Examples: Honesty, Kindness, Courage. (उदाहरण: ईमानदारी, दया, साहस।)
